title: Primitives — `src/components/ui/`
blurb: shadcn/Radix-derived building blocks. Restyle these; never fork one into a feature folder.

components.name: AuroraHero
components.summary: Aceternity "Aurora Background", adapted for the workstation: a contained hero band (not a 100vh marketing section), the palette shifted from Aceternity's blues to the ARN purple family, and the drift wrapped in `motion-safe` (reduced motion gets the same aurora, frozen).

components.name: AuroraWash
components.summary: Aceternity's Aurora Background at micro scale: a corner-masked gradient bloom for a single data block, tinted by the data it sits behind (e.g.

components.name: DotGridBackdrop
components.summary: Aceternity-style dot-grid backdrop, radially masked so it fades toward the edges.

components.name: GlowBorder
components.summary: Aceternity-style moving border: a slowly rotating conic gradient clipped to a 1-2px frame around the content.

components.name: MovingBorder
components.summary: Aceternity "Moving Border", CSS-only: their version animates a glow dot along the border path with motion's getPointAtLength; the same read — light traveling around the edge — comes from rotating an oversized conic gradient behind a 1px-inset inner card.

components.name: Spotlight
components.summary: Aceternity-style spotlight: a soft diagonal light sweep for sparse surfaces (404s, empty heroes).

components.name: SpotlightCard
components.summary: Aceternity-style spotlight card: a radial glow that follows the cursor, plus a border highlight near the pointer.

title: Shared components — `src/components/`
blurb: App-level patterns assembled from the primitives and reused across features.

components.name: CardGridSkeleton
components.summary: Card-grid placeholder for entity-card pages (stations, voices, operators).

components.name: ComposerField
components.summary: One labelled field in a {@link RuleComposer} row: a small muted label above a control.

components.name: DataTableColumnHeader
components.summary: A clickable `<TableHead>` with a sort-direction indicator.

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: The standard in-content empty state: dashed border, centred muted text.

components.name: EntityActionsMenu
components.summary: Shared kebab menu for gallery cards and table rows.

components.name: EntityDiffView
components.summary: Renders one value's diff: a field row shows before → after (git-style strike/highlight), a whole array item added/removed collapses to one tinted `+`/`−` line instead of exploding into its own fields.

components.name: FieldLabel
components.summary: A studio-form field label with its explanation behind a tooltip.

components.name: InfoHint
components.summary: The one "explain this" affordance for the Bulletin-rules hub.

components.name: ListSkeleton
components.summary: Bordered row-list placeholder for the Bulletin-rules hub inventories and the broadcast log.

components.name: LiveAssignmentNotice
components.summary: The one "this is live, saving affects air" banner for every versioned library studio (voices, delivery styles, bookends, pronunciation dictionaries).

components.name: LiveEditConfirmationDialog
components.summary: Shown before saving a NEW version of a library entity that is assigned to stations.

components.name: LoadOlderButton
components.summary: Shared footer control for "Load older" cursor pagination — Activity and History both page this way.

components.name: NavigationBar
components.summary: Mobile top bar.

components.name: Placeholder
components.summary: The standard empty / loading / error state.

components.name: RuleComposer
components.summary: Shared authoring shell for the Bulletin-rules hub composers.

components.name: RuleRow
components.summary: Shared list-row component for the Bulletin-rules hub and editorial guidance inventory.

components.name: RuleTab
components.summary: Shared scaffold for the Bulletin-rules hub tabs.

components.name: RuleToolbar
components.summary: The single row of chrome above every Bulletin-rules list: find, narrow, create — in that order, in the same place, on every tab.

components.name: ScopeGroupedList
components.summary: Shared scope-grouped list for the Bulletin-rules hub: one bordered container with sticky per-scope headers ("{label} (n)") and dense, evenly-divided rows.

components.name: StickyFilterRail
components.summary: Keeps list controls reachable while desktop operators scan long records.

components.name: ViewToggle
components.summary: Cards | Table segmented control for entity-list pages.
